title: Post-Interop continuation API catalog
extraction: Mounted FastAPI OpenAPI/effective routes plus endpoint/helper/direct-service source inspection, using isolated imports under identical dependencies. No lifespan, server, requests, model calls or external network/process launch. Repository runtime unchanged.
interpretation: Every paths array lists actual mounted /api and /api/v1 aliases, not inferred alternatives.
Schema inspection is not endpoint execution evidence; flags, existing host/project/workspace/branch authority and final dispatch checks still apply.
Flags/permission literals are observed referenced checks, sometimes conditional, not unconditional grants or a full authorization proof.

OPENAPI_CONTRACT_CHANGED is a resolved schema/parameter/status delta. SOURCE_VALIDATION_MODEL_CHANGED covers source-referenced validation models, including manually parsed bodies and nested definitions. REFERENCED_IMPLEMENTATION_CHANGED is AST evidence, not a claim of a wire change.
Dynamic {action} parameters stay generic mounted operations. Unknown/unannotated response shapes are not invented.
Counts overlap. Deeper uninspected service dependencies can affect otherwise unchanged operations. This is not a transitive behavioral/security audit or a final CI/model-quality claim.
